title: Read, Edit, and Write

body.text: Read reads a file · Edit changes specific spots · Write creates/rewrites a whole file
— Claude picks which to use for the task; you just state the desired result, and Edit shows a diff of only what changed.

example: "'Add validation to the signup form' → Claude reads the form file (Read) then edits just the submit function (Edit)"

title: Review the diff before accepting

body.text: Every change shows as a red/green diff —
read it before accepting, every time
. If it's not right, reject and say what you want changed; Claude adjusts immediately, no harm done.

example: "The diff shows it'll delete a function that's still used → click no and say 'that function is still used on the admin page, don't delete it'"

question: Which tool edits specific spots in a file?
What do red and green in a diff mean?

options.text: Red = removed lines, green = added lines

question: If the diff isn't right, what should you do?

options.text: Reject and state what you want more clearly
Always accept and fix it later

question: Before accepting Claude Code's file edit, what should you do?

options.text: Review the diff and understand it before accepting

question: What are Read, Edit, Write for?

options.text: Reading, editing, and writing files in the project
